thread:
elaine (docs): FYI the /v1/rerank API example currently shows `queries` as a single string. We removed auto-wrapping of single-string queries; users must send an array of query objects now. Opening a tiny docs PR to fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3141
matt (eng): Thanks — runtime expects `queries: [{ query: string, top_k?: number }]`. Single-string form was deprecated last quarter.
nina (sdk): I'll update SDK examples and types once docs PR is merged. Our TS types still allow legacy shapes; I'll tighten them and add migration notes.
jordan (api): Please include a migration callout: "Previously accepted single-string queries are deprecated; provide an array of query objects. Results correspond to queries via `query_index`." Also note documents can be either an array of strings or an array of objects (e.g., `{ id, text }`).
elaine (docs): Can someone paste a corrected curl + compact response so I can patch PR quickly?
matt (eng): Use this curl example (minimal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-large-v1","queries":[{"query":"Where is tokenization documented?","top_k":5},{"query":"How to set up Dedicated?","top_k":3}],"documents":["Doc A text","Doc B text","Doc C text"]}'
```
matt (eng): Example response (abridged): `{"results":[{"query_index":0,"document_indices":[0,2],"scores":[0.97,0.65]},{"query_index":1,"document_indices":[2,0],"scores":[0.88,0.40]}]}`
nina (sdk): I'll open SDK PR referencing docs PR 3141 and include a migration note in the changelog.
ci-bot: docs build for PR 3141 passed https://ci.redwood.ai/3141/builds/12
elaine (docs): Patch applied: updated curl, added response sample, and migration callout about query objects and `query_index` ordering. Will merge after one proofread. Thanks!
